Presentation: Lolo is the riddle-master (riddling is an elderâ€™s game - culturally apt). â€œPaktakon!
Pamati sing maayoâ€¦ kag pangitaa ang sabat SA ENGLISH!â€ Riddles are spoken in simple Hiligaynon;

THE SIX RIDDLES (full text; answers are all Grade 1 words):
1. â€œMay apat ka tiil ako, nagataghol: aw aw! Ano ako?â€ â†’ dog

6. â€œDiri nagapuyo ang imo pamilya. Diin ako?â€ â†’ house
Format per riddle: Lolo speaks it (a small picture-hint fades in after 5 seconds - the scaffold for

UNIT 5 - POEMS (Binalaybay) - 3 lessons +
GRADE 2 CAPSTONE
Rhyme awareness through short original poems - a documented predictor of early reading and the
on-ramp to Grade 3â€™s Stories. Binalaybay is a proud Hiligaynon tradition; English poems are framed
as the same beloved thing in another language. Near-zero new vocabulary; all poems recycle Grades
1-2 words. ALL POEMS ARE ORIGINAL (copyright-clean).

art, capstone program scenes, all poem audio (line-by-line + full).
